body:
## Pull request overview

Implements additional chart types and introduces new dashboard/report components (MetricCard, ReportViewer, ReportBuilder), along with Storybook examples and initial unit tests.

**Changes:**
- Added pie/donut/radar/scatter support to the advanced chart implementation and registered per-type aliases.
- Added new dashboard/report components (MetricCard, ReportViewer, ReportBuilder) and registered them in the plugin dashboard registry.
- Added Storybook stories and Vitest setup/tests for the new dashboard/report components.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 16 out of 16 changed files in this pull request and generated 14 comments.

| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx | Registers/exports MetricCard, ReportViewer, ReportBuilder in ComponentRegistry. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/MetricCard.tsx | Introduces standalone KPI card component with icon + trend display. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ReportViewer.tsx | Adds report viewer rendering sections (summary/chart/table/text) with toolbar actions. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ReportBuilder.tsx | Adds interactive report configuration UI with field selection and preview. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/MetricCard.test.tsx | Adds basic render tests for MetricCard. |

| packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx | Extends chartType enum options and registers chart-type alias components. |
| packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx | Implements donut/radar/scatter rendering paths and palette cycling for pie/donut. |
| packages/plugin-charts/examples/chart-examples.ts | Adds example schema objects demonstrating new chart types. |
| packages/components/src/stories-json/charts.stories.tsx | Adds Storybook JSON stories for pie/donut/radar/scatter charts. |
| packages/components/src/stories-json/dashboard.stories.tsx | Adds dashboard stories combining MetricCards and charts. |

The PR description claims summary aggregation support, but this code still contains a `TODO: Implement other aggregations` and only handles `count` and `sum`. Either implement the remaining `ReportAggregationType` values or adjust the behavior/description so consumers don't assume full aggregation support.

The "Show in Summary" checkbox does not have an associated label (`htmlFor`/`id`) or `aria-label`, so it may be announced ambiguously by screen readers. Consider giving the checkbox an `id` and wiring the adjacent `

There is a `console.log` in the chart implementation that will run on every render. This can be noisy in production and can significantly impact performance for frequently re-rendered dashboards. Consider removing it or gating it behind an explicit debug flag.

New chart types were added to the `chartType` enum (`pie`, `donut`, `radar`, `scatter`), but the existing unit tests in `packages/plugin-charts/src/index.test.ts` only assert the legacy enum values. Consider extending tests to cover the new enum options and verifying the new alias registrations (`pie-chart`, `donut-chart`, etc.).

`MetricCard` is registered in `ComponentRegistry`, and `SchemaRenderer` always passes a `schema` prop to registered components. Because `MetricCard` collects unknown props into `...props` and spreads them onto `<Card>`, the `schema` object will be forwarded down to the DOM (via Card), causing React "unknown prop" warnings and potentially large attribute serialization. Consider explicitly accepting `schema` and removing it from the props you forward, or avoid spreading unknown props onto the Card root.

`IconComponent` is resolved via `(LucideIcons as any)[icon]`, which removes type safety and can silently render nothing for invalid icon names. Consider using the typed `icons` export from `lucide-react` (as used elsewhere) and narrowing `icon` to a known key type, or validating the icon name and falling back to a default icon.

`ComponentRegistry` is imported but never used in this file. Please remove the unused import to avoid lint/typecheck failures and reduce bundle noise.

The fallback table only renders when `!report.sections`. If `report.sections` is an empty array, no sections will render and the fallback won't run, producing an empty report body even when `data` is present. Consider using `report.sections?.length` (or similar) so empty arrays trigger the fallback behavior too.


Summary aggregation uses `reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item[field.name] || 0), 0)`. If the underlying values are strings (common for API payloads), `+` will concatenate and produce incorrect totals. Consider coercing to number (e.g., `Number(...)`) and handling `NaN`.

Also, other aggregation types (`avg`, `min`, `max`, `distinct`) exist in `ReportAggregationType` but are currently unimplemented here.

`handleSave` uses `console.log` and `alert()` and does not actually invoke a save mechanism beyond the placeholder. Since `ReportBuilderSchema.onSave` is part of the public schema, this should trigger a real callback/action (or at least provide a clear extension point) rather than side-effect UI alerts.

`aggregation: e.target.value as any` defeats the `ReportAggregationType` typing from `@object-ui/types`. Consider narrowing the value to `ReportAggregationType | undefined` (treat empty string as undefined) instead of using `any`, so invalid aggregations can't be introduced via the UI.

`handleExport` uses `console.log` and `alert`, and the export behavior is left as a TODO. Shipping a library component that triggers `alert()` is disruptive for consumers and hard to test. Consider wiring export through the action system / callbacks (e.g., emit an action or invoke a provided handler) and remove `console.log`/`alert` from runtime code.

`ReportSection.visible` in the types is `boolean | string`, but this renderer only hides when `visible === false`. If `visible` is an expression string (per spec), it will be ignored and the section will always render. Consider evaluating string expressions against the report data/context (e.g., via `ExpressionEvaluator`) and using the result to decide visibility.
